title: Website statistics
intro: See how people find the studio and which pages they open.
page_views_note: Successful page loads, including repeat views.
entry_views_note: External referrals and direct / unknown source. These are not unique visitors or sessions.
daily_note: Known bots, assets, errors and privacy opt-out headers are excluded.
sources_note: Sources are broad groups from the referrer or a recognised utm_source. Apps may hide referrers; unrecognised campaign values are ignored.
empty: No page views recorded in this period.
privacy_note: No cookies, visitor IDs, IP addresses, full referrers, raw browser strings or individual browsing histories are stored in these statistics.
limitations: Daily aggregates are kept for 90 days. Page views are not people. Reloads count again, and bot filtering is approximate. Collection is best effort and excludes the GitHub Pages mirror. Refresh this page for current totals.
